unitemized.reason: This rule only applies when the agent makes an assumption, and the engine has no way to observe that. Nothing in the run shows whether an assumption was made, so the condition can't be written as an applies_when predicate (rule 7). The templates also have no fixed section or label for assumptions, so there is nothing a field or section check could target. On top of that, the rule comes from harness system-prompt text, so it could be at most a 'should'. Its intent ('do not pause to ask') is a behavioural instruction that no kind in the vocabulary can check.
